remarks: Enjoy the wonderful combination of comfort, convenience, and breathtaking views from this bright and inviting penthouse 1-bedroom residence at Fountain Terrace. The open-concept floor plan creates a spacious, easy-flowing living environment, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The unit features laminate flooring throughout the living room and bedroom, with attractive tile in the kitchen and bath. Generous closet space, along with an additional pantry/storage area, provides plenty of room for organization. Fountain Terrace is ideally located close to downtown, conveniently situated on the bus line, and just minutes from shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday essentials. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included, along with one assigned parking space-adding to the exceptional convenience and value of this lovely unit. Building Entry: Please ask the guard for the building entry code. An electronic key box is located on the unit door.
